banner: VERSIONED DEVELOPMENT CORPUS. Manually authored, public, non-sensitive example phrases. NO real STT output, NO recordings, NO personal data. Evaluates TEXT ROUTING only. Entries from the router's own phrase tables measure SPECIFICATION CONFORMANCE, not accuracy; AUTHORED_DEVELOPMENT entries are written by the router's author (gold = desired behaviour), are NOT independent and NOT held out. REAL-WORLD INTENT ACCURACY: NOT MEASURED.
notes: source_type is verified mechanically against the router's phrase tables (ROUTER_PHRASE_TABLE iff the text is a table member). The expected category of UNSUPPORTED / AMBIGUOUS / INVALID_INPUT is null; INVALID_COMMAND carries the recognised command category. Real, human-reviewed STT transcripts belong in a separate manifest stored OUTSIDE the repository (see week8_intent_real_stt_manifest.template.json).
